isolation: stateless read-only API; no container to create or own — each scenario asserts directly on the response to its own request

scenarios.rule: A named request receives a personalized greeting
scenarios.scenario: API consumer requests a greeting by name

steps.text: an API consumer sends a GET request to "/hello" with name "Ada"
steps.observed: HTTP/1.1 200 OK, content-type: application/json, body {"message":"Hello, Ada!"}

steps.text: the response is JSON containing a greeting addressed to "Ada"

scenarios.rule: A request with no name still receives a greeting
scenarios.scenario: API consumer omits the name parameter

steps.text: an API consumer sends a GET request to "/hello" with no name parameter
steps.observed: HTTP/1.1 200 OK, content-type: application/json, body {"message":"Hello, World!"}

steps.text: the response is JSON containing a generic greeting addressed to "World"
